=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (BEFORE WRITING) ===
• trino.io/docs/current/functions/datetime.html + IntelliJ/JetBrains Trino-CAST-omits-tz support thread + with_timezone-vs-CAST distinction (web search): `CAST(timestamp → timestamp with time zone)` uses the **SESSION time zone** — `current_timezone()` at query time, which is whatever `SET TIME ZONE` set, or the JDBC client default, or the JVM `-Duser.timezone` on the coordinator. NOT unconditionally UTC.
• `with_timezone(timestamp(p), zone)` directly assigns the given zone to a naive timestamp WITH NO session-zone involvement — explicitly contrasted with `at_timezone()` (which converts from session zone) in the Trino docs.
• `AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'` on a bare timestamp attaches UTC (no session-zone involvement); chained `AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '<local>'` is session-independent.
• `SET TIME ZONE 'zone'` changes the current session's default time zone (trino.io/docs/current/sql/set-time-zone.html); has no effect if `sql.forced-session-time-zone` is set at coordinator.
